contract.conditioning: Original introduced focal allele segregating today in both test and reference cohorts.
contract.test_ascertainment: First 100 accepted new proposals in fixed index order, independent seeds, no reuse or signal ascertainment.
contract.p_definition: (1 + number of reference neutrals >= test neutral) / 101; exact integer comparisons for true TMRCA and median.
